output.title: BR-04 a converted line is rounded in the customer's currency before tax and totals are worked out @critical
output.data_choice: P-1133 bills one approved hour of junior consultant time (85.00 EUR) to Polar Marine Oy in USD at 1.0835, giving 92.0975 USD. Before the BILL-1121 fix the line was not rounded, so tax at 25.5% on the unrounded line would show 23.48 and the total 115.58 USD; rounding the line first gives 92.10, tax 23.49 and total 115.59 USD. The free data has no project with several fractional converted lines, so this test cannot reproduce the multi-line SEK drift in the defect itself; it catches the defect through the tax and total instead.
